changelog.title: Cross-platform build fix and CI pipeline sequencing
highlights: Fixed compilation error on Linux and macOS caused by missing CameraDeviceEnumerator.Other.cs non-Windows partial method implementation.
Replaced mapfile with a Bash 3.2-compatible while-read loop in CI, fixing the macOS build failure.
Auto-tag workflow now waits for CI to succeed before creating a version tag, preventing releases on broken builds.

changelog.title: Reference overlays, Sony CrSDK, in-app updater, and cross-platform improvements
highlights: Reference overlays for single images, image sequences, and video with loop/hold playback controls.
Loop start/end comparison overlay with edge crossfade for seamless loop checks.
Timeline playhead click-and-drag scrubbing and wheel-navigation reliability fixes.
Sony CrSDK discovery, connection, live view, in-app capture transfer, and reliability hardening.
In-app updater powered by versions.json with startup popup and direct download action.
Camera integration UI now exposes backend, SDK/capture mode, and SDK-aware resolution behavior.

changelog.title: Avalonia migration, SDK discovery, project migration, and stability improvements
highlights: Cross-platform migration from WPF to Avalonia for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Advanced Nikon/Canon SDK discovery from local folders and archives.
Hardware-triggered still capture for supported Nikon cameras with auto timeline import.
Project loading plus automatic migration for older project structures.
Added composition overlays and improved frame-by-frame timeline navigation.
Refactored camera backend to ICameraAdapter architecture.
Capture mode update from TIFF + Proxy to PNG + Proxy for master files.
Startup crash and startup performance fixes for safer SDK discovery scans.
Performance and input improvements (histogram rewrite, keyboard debounce, UI responsiveness).

changelog.title: Initial Windows release with capture pipeline, timeline, and integrations
highlights: Initial .NET 10 Windows WPF application with DirectShow live camera preview.
Camera selection, start/stop controls, status feedback, and frame capture workflow.
Onion skin overlays, timeline/playback with scrubbing, and live luminance histogram.
Stream Deck integration for capture, onion toggle, opacity presets, and undo.
TIFF + Proxy and JPEG sequence capture workflows.
Nikon/Canon SDK folder layout and Nikon SDK discovery support.
Nikon NEF/NRW import pipeline to TIFF masters and JPG/PNG proxies.
Build/output restructuring to .artifacts and startup/build reliability fixes.
Improved error reporting and dedicated CHANGELOG introduction.
